title: GM-CSF/IFN tumour-myeloid transcriptome reanalysis: analysis code and reproducibility package
description: Analysis code and reproducibility materials for a quantitative reanalysis of glioblastoma-monocyte transcriptomes examining a partially reversible GM-CSF-associated interferon program and patient-level correlates in operationally mapped monocyte-derived tumour-associated macrophages.
